files.checkInTitle: Check in {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}
files.checkInHelp: Checked in, the files go into the workflow, locked: the CMS preview (Checked in) shows them at once, and they can be pushed to preview. A page's new blocks, styles and layout that are yours come along.
files.checkedIn: Checked in: push them to preview from the Workflow page
files.restoreNeedsMine: Check this file out to restore one of its versions.
files.restoreBody: The current draft becomes this version (unsaved edits are lost). Then check it in and push it to preview and production as usual.
files.restoredMissing: Some blocks or templates this version uses no longer exist
files.barAvailable: Nobody has this file. Check it out and only you can change it.
files.barLocked: {owner} checked it in ({stage}) and it is locked: nobody can check it out or change it until it leaves the workflow.
files.barMine: Checked out by you ({since}): only you can change it. Check it in when it is ready; put it back or discard it otherwise.
files.barTheirs: Checked out by {owner} ({since}): only they can change it. You can take it over if you need to.
files.taken: Checked out: only you can change it now
files.takeOverBody: {owner} is using it. Taken over, it is yours and they can no longer save it (what they saved stays).
files.putBackDone: Put back: the changes stay, anyone can check it out
files.discardTitle: Discard the changes to {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}?
files.discardBody: The files go back to their production version; a new file never published is deleted. This can't be undone (checked-in versions stay in the history).
files.discarded: Discarded: back to the production version
files.name: File

fields.hantHelp: OpenCC turns the Simplified text into Traditional (Taiwan usage), then a few of the app's own words are put in; read it before saving

page.deleteBody: Once on production, this address has no page; its blocks stay and can go on other pages.
page.deleted: Page deleted (a draft: it takes effect once checked in and on production)
page.deletedBody: Checked in and pushed to production, it leaves the website. To keep it after all, discard this file's changes.
page.pathHelp: Change the address and the old one no longer has this page
page.activeSwitch: Active (shown on production; an inactive page is seen in the CMS preview alone)
page.layoutHelp: The page's layout: the zones its blocks go in
page.layoutChanged: With another layout, blocks in zones it lacks show in its main zone, and the editor asks you to move them.
page.availableHelp: Drag one into a row to stand beside its components, or between two rows to make a row of its own; or click it.
page.newRowHelp: Drag it between two rows for an empty row, then drag components into it.
page.emptyRow: An empty row: drag components here
page.emptyRowBadge: Empty (saved once a component is in it)
page.removeRowBody: Its {count} components leave the page; the component files stay, for other pages to use.
page.takeToEdit: Check this page out to change it.
page.emptyZone: No block in this zone yet
page.contentSource: Change content (shared, new or a copy)
page.strayBody: These blocks are in zones the current layout lacks: the site shows them in its main zone. Move them to one of the layout's zones.
page.pickCopy: Pick a “{type}” to copy its content
page.usedInPages: Used in these pages (click to preview)

component.saved: Saved (draft): switch the CMS preview to Drafts to see it
component.deletedBody: Checked in and pushed to production, it is gone. To keep it after all, discard this file's changes.
component.name: Block name (for you; not shown on the website)
component.deleteBody: It is on no page; once checked in and on production it is gone.
component.usedOn: On these pages (its zone and style are changed in the page's editor)
component.unused: On no page yet: add it with “Or add an existing block” in a page's editor.
component.noPreview: This block is on no page, so there is no preview.

mine.title: My files
mine.lead: The files checked out by you: only you can change them. Check several in together, put them back (the changes stay, anyone can check them out) or discard them (back to the production version).
mine.help: A page's new blocks, styles and layout come along when you check it in.
mine.noneHeld: No file is yours now. Tick files in the content tree and take them, or take one in its editor.
mine.inWorkflow: Checked in by me, in the workflow ({n})

workflow.title: Workflow
workflow.lead: Checked-in files are locked in the workflow: first under Checked in, which the CMS preview shows at once; on preview once pushed there; once on production they are production's version again and anyone can check them out. Preview's versions stay in the CMS preview and on preview.
workflow.cmsPreviewHelp: Production with every file in the workflow (Checked in); switch to Drafts for everyone's drafts.
workflow.stageCheckedInHelp: Push the files you pick to preview, or terminate their workflow: they go back to whoever checked them in, checked out, with their changes.
workflow.previewStarted: Pushing to preview ({n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}): the build takes a minute or two
workflow.terminateTitle: Terminate the workflow of {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}?
workflow.terminateBody: The files leave the workflow and go back to whoever checked them in, checked out, with all their changes.
workflow.terminated: Terminated: the files are back with whoever checked them in
workflow.stagePreviewHelp: Push the files you pick to production (those alone: the other files on preview stay there), or send them back to check-in: preview is built again without them.
workflow.emptyPreview: No file on preview is waiting for production.
workflow.toProductionTitle: Push {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} to production?
workflow.toProductionBody: Production's content with these files is committed to the website's repository (content/site.json, a built-in template's code with it, checked and built in the CMS's copy of the website first) and pushed to GitHub; Cloudflare Pages puts www.cameyware.com live in a few minutes. Check them on preview first.
workflow.backTitle: Send {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} back to check-in?
workflow.backBody: Preview is built again without these files; they go back to Checked in, still locked.
workflow.backStarted: Sending back: preview is being built again
workflow.onlyAdmins: Only administrators and super administrators push to production.
workflow.lastDeployment: No deployment is running now. The last one:
workflow.cmsRebuildStarted: Rebuilding the CMS preview: a few minutes
workflow.runLine: {env} · {action} · release {id} · {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {by} · {at}
workflow.releasesHelp: Each push to preview or production is a release. In an emergency production can go back, as a whole, to a release it showed before: that release's file versions become production's again; the files in the workflow stay as they are.
workflow.rollbackBody: Production becomes this release as a whole ({n} differences from now), committed and pushed; preview is built again afterwards. The files in the workflow are not touched.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.lead: Every push to preview or production, every move back, rollback and rebuild is a deployment: here are all of them, the newest first. “Log” opens one's whole output in a new tab.
deployments.searchPlaceholder: Words in the log, a file, who, or a release number
deployments.noFiles: It took no files (a rebuild or a rollback).
deployments.running: Still running: the log refreshes by itself.

transfer.title: Download and upload
transfer.downloadHelp: Downloads are the current drafts (the working copy). A single page (as Bell's WebPage: its metadata and its components), block, style, layout, bundle or global downloads from its own editor. Upload the changed file below: it becomes your draft, ready to check in.
transfer.uploadHelp: JSON or XML, in the format the CMS downloads. It is checked first and lists what it would change; nothing is written until you confirm. Each file it changes must be yours or nobody's (it is checked out for you); one someone else has or in the workflow refuses it. A page file whose address has no page makes a new page (a new address, inactive at first).
transfer.summary: It creates {create}, changes {update} and leaves {same} as they are.
transfer.applied: Written as drafts (checked out to you): check them in from My files

login.title: Cameyware website CMS
login.how: Sign in with your company staff account:
login.step1: Sign in to your account on the company website (website editor, administrator or super administrator).
login.step2: Open My account and, under Website content, click Open the CMS.
login.go: To My account on the website
login.who: Who may sign in, and with which role, is set in 人员与权限 (staff and roles) in 禄命秘解's admin console.

errors.takeFirst: “{id}” is not checked out: check it out to change it
errors.othersFile: “{id}” is checked out by {owner}: only they can change it (you can take it over)
errors.notYours: Some files are not checked out by you
errors.blockInUse: This block is still on a page
errors.textKey: “{key}” is not a UI text's name (such as nav.signIn)
errors.blockMissingAt: The page {path} uses the block {block}, which is not in this release: push it along
errors.releaseIncomplete: This release is incomplete and was not pushed
errors.noManifest: Release {id} was made before CMS v2.0.0 and lists no file versions: production can't go back to it as a whole
errors.previewBusy: Preview is being deployed: try again when it is done
errors.productionBusy: Production is being deployed: try again when it is done
errors.blockNotComing: The page's new block {block} is checked out by {owner}, so it can't come along: take it over first
errors.checkinIncomplete: Not checked in: a page's new blocks must be checked in with it
errors.fileBusy: “{id}” is being deployed: wait until it is done
errors.xmlDoctype: The XML may not have a DOCTYPE or an ENTITY
errors.xmlRoot: The XML's root element should be {tag}
errors.xmlKind: Unknown kind="{kind}" (page, component, template, layout, global, texts or site)
errors.tooBig: The file is too big (8 MB at most)
errors.notCmsFile: This is not a file the CMS downloaded ("cms": 1 and "kind" are missing)
errors.importTypeChange: The block {id} is a {from}; it can't become a {to}
errors.importPathTaken: This address has a page already ({id}); to change it, use its id
errors.importTextShape: The text {key}: should be words in languages
errors.importRefused: The file did not pass the checks: nothing was changed
errors.linkUsed: This sign-in link was used already or has expired: open the CMS again from My account on the website
errors.notStaff: This account has no access to the admin console
errors.roleCannotEdit: Your role ({role}) can't change the website's content
errors.signInFailed: Signing in failed: try again in a moment
errors.cannotEdit: Your role can't change the website's content
errors.cannotPublish: Only administrators and super administrators push to production
errors.cmsSiteBuilding: The CMS preview is being rebuilt: refresh in a few minutes
errors.templateNotComing: The new style {template} a page uses is {owner}'s, so it can't come along: take it over first
errors.templateMissingAt: Page {path}'s block {block} uses style {template}, which isn't in this release: push it too
errors.layoutNotComing: The new layout {layout} a page uses is {owner}'s, so it can't come along: take it over first
errors.layoutMissingAt: Page {path} uses layout {layout}, which isn't in this release: push it too
errors.importNoComponent: No component “{path}”: upload or create it first
errors.codeSuperadmin: Only a super administrator can take or replace a built-in template's code
errors.codeFileName: The file to upload is {file} (this one is {got})
errors.codeProblems: The code didn't pass the checks; nothing was replaced
errors.codeMissing: {ref} has no {file} yet: push the website's code first
errors.codeChanged: {file} on {ref} changed after the CMS took it in (a change of the website's code): discard this file, and change it again once the CMS has taken the new code in
errors.codeConflict: A built-in template's code conflicts; nothing was pushed
errors.codeLint: The code didn't pass the website's checks (eslint; the deployment's log has the details)

codeCheck.tooLong: The code is too long (at most {max} characters)
codeCheck.noDefault: Export the type's view (a component) with export default
codeCheck.import: Line {line}: {module} can't be imported (only the site's components, icons and words)
codeCheck.dynamicImport: Line {line}: no import() of modules at run time
codeCheck.global: Line {line}: {name} can't be used (no network, storage, other windows, code from text or Node)
codeCheck.property: Line {line}: {name} can't be used (no cookies, HTML written as text or beacons)
codeCheck.attribute: Line {line}: {name} can't be used (only the rich text and freeform HTML views need it)

check.notLink: {path}: “{value}” is not an address (starting with / or https://)
check.notOption: {path}: “{value}” is not one of the choices ({options})
check.notLocalized: {path}: one text for every language, not one per language
check.notFields: {path}: should be a set of fields
check.pagePath: The address “{path}” won't do: it starts and ends with /, has lower-case letters, digits and hyphens alone, and is none of the website's own pages (account, sign-in and so on)
check.pathTaken: The address “{path}” has a page already
check.pageStatus: The status is active or inactive
check.name: {label}
check.badZone: Zone name “{zone}” won't do: lower-case letters, digits, - and _
check.badRow: Row key “{row}” won't do: lower-case letters, digits and -

notes.blockCopied: The block {from} is used elsewhere already: copied as the new {to}
notes.pageIdUsed: The page id {from} was used by a deleted page: the new page is {to}
notes.newPageInactive: New page {path}: inactive at first; activate it once checked
notes.templateCopied: Template {from} is of another type: copied as a new one, {to}
notes.layoutCopied: Layout {from} exists already: copied as a new one, {to}

deploy.productionSame: Production has this content already: nothing to commit.
deploy.productionDone: Pushed to GitHub; Cloudflare Pages builds www.cameyware.com and puts it live in a few minutes.
deploy.interrupted: (The CMS restarted: this deployment was interrupted)
deploy.seed: First content: the website's content/site.json at the time, on both preview and production.

explorer.matchedStyles: Matching styles: {label} ({n, plural, one {# template} other {# templates}})
explorer.matchedContent: Matching content: {label} ({n, plural, one {# block} other {# blocks}})

about.content: The site's content: pages, components (blocks) by type, resource bundles and globals.
about.pages: Each page of the site, by its address. Active ones go to production; inactive ones show in the CMS preview only.
about.components: Blocks by type: a folder per type, matching the folder of the same name under Views / Component styles.
about.componentType: Every block (content) of this type. Each is drawn by a template: the built-in one or one of its component styles.
about.common: What the whole site shares: resource bundles (the UI texts) and globals (company, header, footer, works, site title).
about.bundles: Every UI text of the site, in resource bundles by namespace: each bundle is one file, taken, checked in and versioned whole.
about.globals: The company's details, header, footer, works and site title: each one file.
about.views: How the content is shown: component styles (templates).
about.styles: The templates of each block type, matching the folder of the same name under Content / Components.
about.styleType: Every template of this type: the built-in one is in the website's code; the others are written in the CMS, taken, checked in and through the workflow like content.
about.layouts: How a page is laid out: four built-in ones (Standard, Home page, Landing page, Article) in the website's code, and new ones written in the CMS, with zones where the blocks go. Every layout has the site's header and footer.

explorer.takeOverMany: Someone else has these files. Taken over, they are yours and the other person can no longer save them (what they saved stays).
explorer.builtinAbout: A file of the website's code; a super administrator can replace it
explorer.onPages: On {n, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}
explorer.pathHelp: Starting and ending with /, lower-case letters, digits and hyphens: /about-us/ or /works/new-app/

newHelp.page: A new page starts inactive and yours: add its blocks, check it, then make it active and check it in.
newHelp.block: A new block is yours: fill it in, then add it to a page from the page's editor.
newHelp.template: A new template is yours: write its markup, choose it on a block, then check in (the block brings it along).
newHelp.layout: A new layout is yours: write its markup, choose it in a page's Metadata, then check in (the page brings it along).

dashboard.title: Overview: who is doing what
dashboard.lead: Whose name each file is in now, where it is in the workflow, and who changed what lately.
dashboard.whoLead: The files each person has taken, and those they checked in that are still in the workflow. A file opens on a click.
dashboard.nobody: Nobody has taken a file, and the workflow is empty.

explorer.cmsSiteHelp: Rebuild it after a change to the website's code; content needs no rebuild.
explorer.rebuildStarted: Rebuilding the CMS preview: a few minutes
explorer.uses: {n, plural, one {used in # place} other {used in # places}}
explorer.laidOut: {n, plural, one {# page uses it} other {# pages use it}}
explorer.builtinLayoutAbout: In the website's code; not editable in the CMS

template.lead: How a “{type}” block looks: markup of the site's components and the block's fields.
template.deletedBody: Checked in and pushed to production, it is gone. To keep it: discard this file's changes.
template.name: Template name
template.markupHelp: The site's components and the block's fields; every way of writing it is in the Reference below. It is checked before it is saved.
template.deleteBody: No block uses it; checked in and pushed to production, it is gone.
template.noBlocks: No block uses it yet: choose it for a block in a page's editor.

syntax.field: A field's value (already in the page's language); in attributes too, such as a link.
syntax.count: Inside Each or Works: the item's number (from 1).
syntax.text: A UI text of the resource bundles (in the page's language).
syntax.each: Each item of a list field: inside, the item's fields.
syntax.if: Shown only when the field has something; not, the other way round; is compares an option's value.
syntax.works: Every work, or the one slug names: inside, name, tagline, lead, status, page, icon, art.
syntax.safe: Only the elements and attributes listed below; no script, event or style code; links only to /, https://, mailto:, tel: or #. For any HTML and scripts, use a Freeform HTML block.

template.previewHelp: The preview shows the saved draft and refreshes after a save. A block must be on a page to be previewed.
template.noPreview: No block of this type is on a page yet: nothing to preview.
template.builtinBody: The built-in template is a file of the website's code ({file}); every block placed without a style uses it. It has a state and versions like any file: a super administrator downloads it, changes it and uploads the same file to replace it, checks it in, pushes it to preview (the cms-preview branch) and then to production (GitHub's main). For another look without code: create a template and choose it on the page.
template.codeUploaded: Draft replaced: once checked in, the CMS preview is rebuilt (a minute or two)
template.codeHelp: The file to upload is {file}. Nobody's file is taken as yours first; one that is someone else's or in the workflow can't be uploaded. The upload is checked: it imports only the site's components, icons and words, and uses no network, storage or cookies, no HTML written as text and no scripts; it is laid out as the website's code is. On the way to preview and production it passes the website's eslint and build too.
template.codeOnlySuper: Only a super administrator can take and replace the code; you can view and download it.
template.codeNoFile: The website's code (main) has no {file} yet: once the code has it, the CMS takes it in the next time this page opens.

standing.changed: This file changed in the website's code (main) and the CMS hasn't taken it in: while someone has it or it is in the workflow, it can't go to preview. Once it is discarded (or pushed), the CMS takes the new code in the next time this page opens.
standing.behind: The version the CMS pushed to GitHub isn't in this computer's website code yet (main is behind): previews use the CMS's version all the same.

markup.leaf: Line {line}: {tag} takes nothing inside (close it on itself)
markup.unknownField: Line {line}: there is no field {name} here
markup.listAsText: Line {line}: {name} is a list: show its items with Each
markup.notHtml: Line {line}: {name} isn't a rich text (HTML) field
markup.countOutside: Line {line}: the number goes only inside Each or Works
markup.unknownText: Line {line}: no resource bundle has the text {key}
markup.badBinding: Line {line}: a brace is wrong (a field is written {example}, braces themselves {braces})
markup.tooLong: The template is too long (at most {max} characters)
markup.tooDeep: Line {line}: nested too deep (at most {max} levels)
markup.unclosedComment: Line {line}: a comment is never closed
markup.badTag: Line {line}: a tag is malformed (attribute values need quotes)
markup.mismatch: Line {line}: {close} closes the wrong element: {open} from line {opened} is still open
markup.layoutOnly: Line {line}: {tag} goes only in a page layout
markup.noZone: A layout needs at least one zone (a Zone element)

bundle.lead: This bundle's {n, plural, one {# UI text} other {# UI texts}}, in four languages. The whole bundle is one file: take it to change it; it is checked in whole.
bundle.addHelp: Only keys the website's code uses show on the site; texts the code adds come into the bundles by themselves.

layout.lead: How a page is laid out: the site's components, with a zone where each zone's blocks go. The site adds its header and footer.
layout.deletedBody: Checked in and pushed to production, it is gone. To keep it: discard this file's changes.
layout.name: Layout name
layout.markupHelp: Written as a template is, with one more element, the zone; see below. It is checked before it is saved.
layout.deleteBody: No page uses it; checked in and pushed to production, it is gone.
layout.noPages: No page uses it yet: choose it in a page's Metadata.

syntax.zone: A zone: the page's blocks in this zone, in order. Its name: lower-case letters, digits, - and _, each zone once.
syntax.page: The page's own title and description (in the page's language).
syntax.grid: Two columns: the main one 8 parts and the side 4 on a wide screen, one under the other on a phone.
syntax.shell: No header or footer to write: the site adds them. For any HTML and scripts, use a Freeform HTML block.

layout.previewHelp: The preview shows the saved draft and refreshes after a save.
layout.builtinBody: Built-in layouts are in the website's code (src/cms/render.tsx) and can't be changed in the CMS. For another look: make a new layout from it, then choose it in a page's Metadata.
